hook.name: RobinhoodV4SelectableFeeHook
hook.description: A token-launchpad hook that charges a fixed 1.5% base fee plus a configurable 0–10% creator fee on the payment-token side of each swap. Fees are collected in beforeSwap/afterSwap via delta returns and minted as ERC-6909 claims to a designated recipient. Pool fee configs and LP positions are immutable after factory registration.
